use_case: Predictive maintenance: wireless vibration sensors on customer motors with AI fault diagnosis (bearing wear, misalignment, imbalance) in a vendor SaaS dashboard and phone app
vendor_or_model: Vibration analytics SaaS vendor (vendor-trained machine learning model; trial on click-through terms)
data_categories: Vibration and temperature readings; motor nameplate data; machine and plant names (Restricted customer data); no personal data
consequential_decision_category: None today (advisory maintenance recommendations); re-tier to Safety/CI if a prediction is used to skip or extend scheduled maintenance or is connected to machine controls
human_in_the_loop: Owner confirms every predicted fault with a handheld vibration reading or thermal image before recommending work; a 'healthy' prediction never replaces a scheduled inspection; the customer decides every repair
applicable_laws: No sector or state AI rule applies; Customer A exhibit S1 (written consent before disclosure to an AI service; P03 G-036); local plant agreement; CSF 2.0 benchmark (P03 G-005)
status: Pilot (trial since 2026-05-04); continue with conditions: Customer A uploads stopped 2026-09-02 pending written consent under a no-training data addendum; otherwise remove sensors and request deletion by 2026-10-31

use_case: Consumer generative AI assistant used on the phone to draft emails and quotes and to look up the meaning of published fault codes
vendor_or_model: Consumer generative AI assistant (general-purpose language model)
data_categories: Public information only; risk that customer programs, drawings, or passwords are pasted
risk_tier: Low for Public information; prohibited for Restricted and Confidential data
human_in_the_loop: Owner reviews every draft before sending; fault code meanings checked against the maker's manual
applicable_laws: Customer A exhibit S1 and the B and C NDAs bar customer data in third-party AI services without consent (POL-01 12.4)
status: Approved with restrictions (Public information only, POL-01 12.4)
